text:
zoe: FYI trying to publish the JS SDK for the sample app; regendiff blocked the pipeline because a generated examples block reordered keys and the semver gate flagged a minor.

mike: ugh, that ordering-only churn again. paste the tiny diff?

zoe:````diff
-  examples:
-    - value: {
-        "role": "assistant",
-        "text": "ok"
-      }
+  examples:
+    - value: {
+        "text": "ok",
+        "role": "assistant"
+      }
````

ranjit: That's from the new stable-serialize in typegen. No API surface change. We should treat example-object key reorders as non-semver.

regendiff-bot: Automated: regen diff in packages/sdk-js/src/generated/ChatExamples.ts. Classified as examples-only. Semver-lens: candidate minor bump.

mike: Two quick paths: (1) manual approval from release-ops to let this publish through, (2) quick dev-tools change to canonicalize example objects before computing diffs so ordering diffs are ignored. (2) prevents future noise.

zoe: release-ops, can you approve a one-off if we open a PR documenting the change?

release-ops: I can approve but need a PR link and short justification in the release UI.

ranjit: I'll open a tiny PR to dev-tools that canonicalizes examples during regendiff comparison and adds an opt-in marker comment `// regendiff: ignore-example-order` in generated files. I'll also add unit tests for nested objects. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/dev-tools/pull/403

ci-bot: CI: publish pipeline #2231 failed at regendiff gate (exit 1).

regendiff-bot: New commit applied from PR 403. Re-running regendiff: reports "examples-only ordering change ignored". No semver bump detected.

ci-bot: CI: publish pipeline #2232 passed regendiff check.

zoe: proceeding with `yarn lerna publish from-package --yes`. will add a note to the release playbook about this pattern.

mike: follow-up: (A) land canonicalizer across language SDKs, (B) decide whether typegen should preserve explicit example ordering or not (product decision), (C) add a small audit to detect other generated docs that cause semver noise.

zoe: publish succeeded. thanks all :tada:
